physical_equations.fixed_gain: R_fixed uses minimum normalized gain; V_ref_tile/V_ref_max = min_gain/gain_tile

assumptions: common conductance span and DAC full scale across tiles
signed row drive and differential subtraction

rounding_check.scope: four training probes per tile plus analytic bound over all DAC-code vectors; compares real-valued code products to mathematical dots of rounded operands, excluding FP32 GEMM accumulation error and physical effects
rounding_check.residual_cause: ideal equispaced real-valued DAC/conductance codes versus rounded float32 input and weight products

claim_boundary: Relative gains and code requirements derived from real model data. No demonstrated device levels, gain circuit, voltage range, noise or timing/energy benefit.
